constraints: This interprocedural CFG has independent roots for public calls, module initialization and setup. index_import is the primary module entry. Internal call instructions describe the invocation at that site; each normal return is a fresh version at that site, independent of the versions in the public callable body.

A return terminates its own invocation. completion=throw propagates the exception. Unless caught by source code, a throw or rejected await exits exceptionally and does not take the normal successor. A later failure does not undo earlier writes or establish whether a remote request took effect.
Qualified context keys identify public parameters. Omission and explicit null are distinct. Parameter and destructuring defaults apply to undefined, separately from source truthiness tests.

Each call_get_client, call_get_search_console_client and call_get_indexing_client returns the existing handle with its creation-time credentials on a hit. On a miss it validates current settings, may fail before any service request, and may construct and cache a distinct handle. Request target getters, parsers that use defaults, and storage read their own settings versions.

Internal GA4 report, Search Console and realtime helper calls take the operands at their own call sites and return the corresponding acquired payload. They perform the source-default child saves before fulfillment unless explicitly disabled. Internal save_result instructions pass their actual payload, category, operation and optional extra to saveResult and discard its returned path. The public saver returns the path. Replace is the runtime write abstraction; the write has no file-content output.

Collection headers dispatch with has_member on the collection. A member instruction selects only the current element. Merge predecessor maps name the incoming block and its input index; a filter skip carries the accumulator forward unchanged. Local collection append is distinct from filesystem operations.

console.log(`
GA4 Analytics Toolkit
=====================

GA4 High-level functions:
  - siteOverview(dateRange?)        Comprehensive site snapshot
  - trafficAnalysis(dateRange?)     Deep dive on sources
  - contentPerformance(dateRange?)  Top pages analysis
  - userBehavior(dateRange?)        Engagement patterns
  - compareDateRanges(range1, range2)  Period comparison
  - liveSnapshot()                  Real-time data

Search Console functions:
  - searchConsoleOverview(dateRange?)  Combined SEO snapshot
  - keywordAnalysis(dateRange?)        Query/keyword analysis
  - seoPagePerformance(dateRange?)     Page-level SEO metrics
  - getTopQueries(dateRange?)          Top search queries
  - getTopPages(dateRange?)            Top pages by clicks
  - getDevicePerformance(dateRange?)   Mobile vs desktop
  - getCountryPerformance(dateRange?)  Traffic by country

Indexing functions:
  - reindexUrls(urls)                  Request re-indexing for URLs
  - checkIndexStatus(urls)             Check if URLs are indexed
  - requestIndexing(url)               Request single URL re-crawl
  - inspectUrl(url)                    Inspect URL index status

Low-level GA4 functions:
  - runReport({ dimensions, metrics, dateRange })
  - getPageViews(dateRange?)
  - getTrafficSources(dateRange?)
  - getUserDemographics(dateRange?)
  - getEventCounts(dateRange?)
  - getActiveUsers()
  - getRealtimeEvents()
  - getPropertyMetadata()

All results are automatically saved to /results directory.
`);
